question: dame la lista de clientes nacidos antes de 1990
sql: SELECT customer_sk, first_name, last_name_1, last_name_2, email, phone_e164, country_code, city_id, region_code, postal_code, income_tier, value_tier, primary_category, segment_code, signed_up_on, marketing_opt_in, is_business_account, support_note, kyc_status, kyc_verified_on, erasure_requested_on, retention_expires_on, birth_date, age_band FROM dim_customer WHERE birth_date < '1990-01-01' ORDER BY birth_date
